$comment: Locked Keep the Line chrome. No STEADI, stand counts, or clinical labels.

lobby.tagline: Full-screen Fruit Ninja on your camera. Sit to stand with knees over feet — slice fruit for hits, avoid bombs when form breaks.

picker.title: Who is playing?
picker.body: Pick a synthetic patient. You’ll see their condition, then today’s Fruit Ninja sit-to-stand.

condition.game_why: Chair sit-to-stand. Camera tracks your body; fruit on your knees scores form. Not a score chart — hits and misses only.

howto.title: How to play
howto.body: Fruit on knees = good form. Bombs = knees drifting in or hands pushing off. Slice hits when you keep the line. Stop is always on screen.

ready.title: Before you start
ready.body: Sturdy chair behind you? Feeling OK to start?

frame.title: We need to see you
frame.body: Stand so your hips, knees, and feet are in the outline.

live.prompt: Slice the fruit — sit to stand
live.how: Watermelon on knees = good form. Bombs = knees in or hands pushing off.
live.step_back: Step back so we can see your knees — then keep playing.

close.title: Your session
close.care_team: Your care team can review this session on the clinic board.
